subject: Starbucks Bearista cup
title: What is the Bearista cup? Starbucks' mystery bear cups, explained
answer: The Bearista is Starbucks' bear-shaped glass cold cup: a bear in a winter cap, in Starbucks green, with the cap as the lid. It sold out within hours in November 2025. For 2026, Starbucks is selling mystery "Surprise Box" Bearistas starting Nov. 10, and the original Bearista returns to select U.S. stores on Dec. 1, while supplies last.
body:
The first Bearista Glass Cold Cup, a 20-ounce glass cup shaped like a bear in a winter cap, in Starbucks' signature green, went on sale on Nov. 6, 2025, for $29.95, Quartz reported. It sold out within hours, some stores got only one or two, and resale listings on eBay and Mercari ranged from $150 to more than $1,000. Starbucks apologized, saying "excitement for our merchandise exceeded even our biggest expectations."

On Oct. 26, 2026, Starbucks said the Bearista was coming back with a twist. The Surprise Box Edition goes on sale Nov. 10 in limited quantities: each box holds a mystery glass Bearista, and buyers find out which design they got only when they open it. The original Bearista returns to select U.S. coffeehouses on Dec. 1. Reports did not list 2026 prices or purchase limits.

The cups are part of Starbucks' holiday season lineup. Red Cup Day, when customers get a free reusable cup with an eligible handcrafted holiday drink, is Nov. 17, 2026, the same day a Winter Wonderland drinkware collection launches.
in_the_news: Starbucks' mystery Bearista Surprise Boxes go on sale Nov. 10, 2026, a year after the original cup sold out in hours.

faq.q: When do the 2026 Bearista cups come out?
faq.a: Mystery Surprise Box Bearistas go on sale Nov. 10, 2026. The original Bearista returns on Dec. 1 at select U.S. stores.

faq.q: How much was the Bearista cup?
faq.a: The original 20-ounce cup cost $29.95 in 2025. Prices for 2026 were not included in the announcement as reported.

faq.q: What is in the Starbucks mystery Bearista box?
faq.a: One glass Bearista cold cup in a design you don't see until you open the box.

faq.q: Why was the Bearista cup so popular?
faq.a: It sold out within hours on Nov. 6, 2025, and resellers listed it for $150 to more than $1,000.
